# World Bank Codes — Comprehensive Agent Documentation

> Full specification, directory hierarchy, and verification algorithms for World Bank Codes (worldbankcodes.com).

## System Architecture
World Bank Codes provides an indexed relational architecture of financial institution data across 8 countries. Every entity is mapped with its verified regulatory identifier, regional administrative hierarchy, and international settlement endpoints.

### National Clearing Code Types
1. **US ABA Routing Transit Number (RTN)**: 9 digits. Modulo 10 weighted checksum: `(3*(d1+d4+d7) + 7*(d2+d5+d8) + 1*(d3+d6+d9)) % 10 === 0`.
2. **UK Sort Code**: 6 digits formatted as `XX-XX-XX`. First 2 digits identify the clearing bank, next 4 identify branch.
3. **Australia BSB Code**: 6 digits formatted as `XXX-XXX`. First 2 digits bank code, 3rd digit state code, last 3 branch code.
4. **Canada Transit & EFT Routing**: 5-digit Branch Transit, 3-digit Financial Institution Number, and combined 9-digit EFT (`0YYYXXXXX`).
5. **UAE CBUAE Routing**: 9-digit Central Bank routing and 23-character UAE IBAN (`AEkk...`).
6. **India IFSC Code**: 11 characters. 4-letter bank code + 5th character '0' + 6 alphanumeric branch code.
7. **Bangladesh BEFTN Routing**: 9 digits. First 3 bank code, next 3 district code, last 3 branch code.
8. **Russia BIK (БИК)**: 9 digits starting with `04`. Modulo checksum validation with 9th control digit.

### Canonical Endpoints
- Homepage: `https://worldbankcodes.com/`
- Bank Details: `https://worldbankcodes.com/bank/:bankId`
- Branch Details: `https://worldbankcodes.com/branch/:code`
- Country Banks: `https://worldbankcodes.com/banks?country=:countryCode`
- SWIFT Finder: `https://worldbankcodes.com/swift`
- Sitemaps: `https://worldbankcodes.com/sitemap_index.xml`
